# M6: Memory

Memory is the factory's guardrails, learned from its own runs. It lives in Postgres, in its own
`memory` database with pgvector, behind one service that alone opens it. Every writer holds a
token for one role, and memory refuses any write outside it: the factory proposes, memory's own
rules confirm, and a person approves anything meant to hold everywhere. A lesson is one to three
sentences of advice that cites the frames of the run it came from, carries a confidence, and
says whether it was seen on those frames or is a guess. The Supervisor reads memory before it
reasons, through the knowledge pack and `memory_query`, and records what the run taught at the
end, through `record_lesson`. Memory starts from the cleaned set in `seeds/memory/`, loaded
through its own door. The plan's
[Appendix K](../plan/GENERIC_BANK_PLAN.md#appendix-k-memory-how-the-agents-remember) is the
specification, with [§K.5](../plan/GENERIC_BANK_PLAN.md#k5-guardrails) for who may write what,
[§K.10](../plan/GENERIC_BANK_PLAN.md#k10-the-starting-knowledge) for the seed and
[§M.4](../plan/GENERIC_BANK_PLAN.md#m4-tools) for the factory's tools.

The change log is the judge throughout. No model decides anything inside memory: every rule is a
fixed function of stored evidence, so a test states exactly which versions and change-log rows a
write must leave behind, and reads them back.

| # | Pull request | What it adds | What proves it |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Memory's tables** | Memory's own Prisma schema and first migration on the `memory` database: episodes (runs and attempts), hypotheses, facts as bi-temporal rows (`valid_at`, `invalid_at`, `expired_at`), lessons and their versions, the catalog (rules, checks, scenarios, approaches), and an embedding column in pgvector; every write and its change-log row in one serializable transaction, hash-chained; `history` and `history/verify`; a chain that fails verification turns memory read-only | the migration applies to an empty `memory` database; changing any change-log row breaks verification at that row, and the next write is refused |
| 2 | **One door** | A token per role (runner, factory, curator, system), each limited to the writes §K.5 gives it; every write signed with a key only deterministic code holds; the privacy screen on every write; `401`, `403 role_forbidden` and `422` as §K.11 gives them | for every role and every write, the allowed ones succeed and the rest are `403` with nothing written; an unsigned write is `403`; a password, code, token, account-like number, screenshot or advice to do a forbidden action is `422` |
| 3 | **Episodes and lessons** | `episodes/runs`, `episodes/attempts`, hypotheses, `lessons/proposals` and `lessons/relied-on`; a lesson cites its run, frames and evidence hash, carries a confidence (low, medium, high) and is marked seen or guess; `bge-small-en-v1.5` in-process for embeddings; a proposal within 0.95 similarity of a lesson in the same scope adds its evidence to that lesson | a lesson with no frame is refused; a near-duplicate grows the held lesson's evidence and adds no lesson; an attempt with no run is `409` |
| 4 | **The seed** | `make memory-seed`: the manifest's hashes checked, then every entry through the door as the curator, with one approval record for the whole set; seeded lessons start as curated patterns; `scenarios`, `approaches`, `rules`, `checks` and `lessons` read at any version | on a fresh database the counts match the manifest (19 rules, 7 checks, 268 lessons, 49 scenarios, 46 approaches) and the chain verifies; a second run writes nothing; a file whose hash differs is refused whole |
| 5 | **Search and the knowledge pack** | Hybrid search: full-text ranking and pgvector similarity fused by reciprocal rank; `episodes/search`, `/recent` and `/recurring`; `knowledge/pack` in tiers within a size budget (patterns, vendor, tenant, proposed marked "verify before relying", disputed with the reason, recurring failures, the two nearest drivers); the query behind `memory_query`, at most eight items and three facts | the pack for bank 2 comes in tier order within its budget, labels every unconfirmed lesson, and never holds a hypothesis or an unconfirmed pattern |
| 6 | **The rules and facts** | Promotion confirms the lessons its probation runs proposed or relied on and writes the bank's verified facts in a fixed vocabulary; one contradiction disputes, two retire, a lesson wrong at one bank retires there only, two banks of a vendor widen it, three vendors make a pattern candidate that waits for a person, a later promoted run brings a retired lesson back, a demotion disputes what its promotion confirmed; `facts`, `facts/search`, `facts/invalidate`, `lessons/confirm`, `lessons/retire`, `curated`, `curated/approve` | each rule, from stored episodes alone, leaves the versions and change-log rows the plan gives it; a fact with no successful run is `409`; a fact search as of a past run returns what memory believed then |
| 7 | **The recorder** | Every run the system settles writes one episode through an outbox, with the runner's token; memory being down never changes a task's result | with memory stopped, runs finish as before; once it is back, each run's episode arrives exactly once |
| 8 | **The factory reads and writes memory** | Intake fetches the knowledge pack and the Supervisor reads it before its first turn; no pack, no run; `memory_query` for both roles, read-only; `record_lesson` for the Supervisor: one to three sentences, a confidence, the frames of this run that show it, seen or guess; at the run's end the lessons go to memory as proposals with what the run relied on and contradicted; the recorded mock run carries them | a mock run on bank 2 starts from the pack and ends with its lessons proposed in memory, each citing its frames; a lesson citing no frame or another run's frame is refused; the Scout cannot call `record_lesson` |
| 9 | **Export and import** | `make memory-export` writes lessons, rules, checks, scenarios, approaches, facts and the change log to a versioned bundle under `exports/` with a hash for every file; `make memory-import` checks every hash and restores | export, reset and import: every count and version matches and the chain verifies; a changed file is refused |
| 10 | **The memory suite** | `tests/memory`: the role matrix, the privacy screen, the seed, every rule, the pack, a tampered change log, and the outbox, all through the Memory service's API | the suite is green and CI fails if it is skipped |
